title: Texans see "three-down back" in David Montgomery

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Texans see "three-down back" in David Montgomery
sources.description: David Montgomery went from the No. 1 back in Detroit to playing second fiddle to Jahmyr Gibbs over the last three seasons, but the Texans still think Montgomery is capable of being the lead back in an offensive attack.
